entities.summary: Ishinosuke Uwano  was a Japanese soldier who later became a Soviet and Ukrainian citizen. An officer in the Imperial Japanese Army, he was captured as a Soviet prisoner of war. Declared dead in Japan, he attracted media attention in April 2006 after he was discovered alive in Ukraine, where he lived voluntarily after his release.
